test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

LIBERTY
solution:
The correct answer is: freedom

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Liberty means the freedom to live as you wish or go where you want.

 
 
• Example - *We must defend our civil **liberties **at all costs.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Freedom means the condition or right of being able or allowed to do, say, think, etc.
 
 
• Example - *You have the **freedom **to come and go as you please*.
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Liberty' and 'Freedom' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Slavery means the condition of being enslaved, held, or owned as human chattel or property.
 
• Bondage means the state of being a slave.
 
• Captivity means the state of being kept in a place that you cannot escape from.
